title: What It Actually Looks Like to Work Hard and Trust God With the Result
caption:
Effort is yours. The result is God's.

A man who only grinds is trusting his hours. A man who only coasts is trusting nothing. Do your part, name what isn't yours, and hand it over before you sleep.

Which side do you lean on: grinding or coasting?

#faith #work #trustgod #godlymen #christianman #psalm127
